label: Theory q' recurrent return-action surface - NLSE curriculum T1s to 900s - friction 0 to 17.5bps - dropout 5%

transition.state: the complete checkpoint-compatible recurrent market and path state advances by its learned shared one-second transition

architecture.output: one GNGLU maps the recurrent market embedding W to an O x A q' surface; the return axis uses piecewise-linear reconstruction on the density model's learned component-return grid and the action axis is uniform on [-1,1]
architecture.policy: integrate the q' surface over the predicted return marginal, add the exact current-exposure rebalance log reward, then argmax over the uniform exposure grid

rl.estimatedFunction: q'(market log-return state, target exposure); current portfolio state enters only through the exact rebalance reward outside q'
rl.objective: probability-weighted squared Bellman error over the complete O x A surface
rl.continuation: uniform-action normalized temperature-scaled log-sum-exp of log R(portfolio transition) + q' at the predicted next recurrent market state

selection.validationSchedule: every 4 epochs at temperature 0.01, friction 17.5bps, T=900s, dt=60s
selection.testPolicy: sealed until the best final-target validation checkpoint is selected
